facts.fact: Saskia 推断自己梦游时用厨师刀捅开 Lucy 的橡皮门挡，再用钥匙打开邻居的锁门
facts.anchor: she used the knife to knock Lucy’s rubber stopper away

facts.fact: 她又一次醒在熟睡的 Lucy 身边、手里握着刀，反复重演一生中最糟的那天
facts.anchor: she woke up standing over a sleeping Lucy with a knife in her hand

facts.fact: 门挡是 Saskia 的主意，是她保护 Lucy 的另一种办法，而 Lucy 并不懂她有多危险
facts.anchor: The doorstop was her idea, another way to protect Lucy.

facts.fact: 第一任男友握住她手腕、让手指绕一圈重叠，边比划边说「我能轻易掰断你的胳膊」
facts.anchor: “I could snap your arm so easily,” he liked to say

facts.fact: 大学时交往的女孩求她扮芭蕾舞者：把长丝带缠上腿、挤进肉色紧身衣当前戏
facts.anchor: tie long ribbons up her legs and squeeze into a flesh-colored leotard

facts.fact: 她用短指甲从内侧手臂挤出三颗小种子，指甲下还有六颗、睫毛里四颗，全收在一张纸巾上
facts.anchor: she uses her short nails to pop out three tiny seeds

facts.fact: 她决定把种子种下去做实验看会长成什么，还自比《恐怖小店》里 Seymour 的 Audrey II
facts.anchor: She is going to plant them and see what they become.

facts.fact: 章末落点（本章 POV＝Saskia，全章贴身第三人称）：她刚把脚缩回被子，就听见 Lucy 尖叫
facts.anchor: She has just slipped her feet back under the covers when she hears Lucy scream
